newsitem.title: UK: Granada to sell computer services arm - paper.
newsitem.headline: Granada to sell computer services arm - paper.

text.p: British media and leisure company Granada Group Plc is poised to sell its computer services division to a management buyout team, said Wednesday's edition of the Times newspaper.
The newspaper said that a confidential memorandum, circulated to senior executives, suggests that the deal will be completed in September.
Analysts do not expect the business to fetch more than 80 million pounds ($130 million), said the Times.
Granada took a 166.7 million pounds goodwill write-off relating to its computer services arm and other items in its first half results released in June.
No one at Granada was immediately available for comment.
